# Project Atlas — Q2 Status Report

## Delivery

Invoice generation is sixty-two percent complete and tracking to plan. Payment
reconciliation sits at forty percent, behind plan because the infrastructure
migration slipped. Work on the customer statement mailer has not started and is
sequenced after reconciliation.

## Spend

One point four million dollars of the approved budget has been spent to date,
against a plan of one point seven million. The underspend is almost entirely
infrastructure that was not provisioned because the migration slipped.

## Blockers

Two blockers are open. First, the malformed historical invoices must be cleaned
before reconciliation testing can be trusted. Second, the staging replica needed
for early testing was only provisioned in May, compressing the test window
further.

## Forecast

The team expects to close invoice generation in Q3 and to begin the statement
mailer integration in Q4, assuming the cleanup is staffed.
